title: gomphandra javanica
intro: Gomphandra javanica, commonly known as the Java oak or Java tree, is a species of plant in the family Stemonuraceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine and is valued for its numerous health benefits, which include the treatment of fever, inflammation, and digestive issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antipyretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Gomphandra javanica are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, that exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. Additionally, Gomphandra javanica has been used in traditional medicine to support the immune system and to treat various respiratory issues due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory properties.
